decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out accessories (cables, cases) and obsolete hardware (Bose 30-pin dock) to focus on modern portable speakers. My consideration set includes high-performance models from JBL, Sony, and Harman Kardon, as well as a well-reviewed budget option from Ortizan. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) is the clear winner due to its exceptional 4.8-star rating from over 16,000 reviews, IP67 rating, and reliable battery life. While the Harman Kardon offers premium sound, the JBL's versatility and ruggedness make it the more practical choice for a portable speaker purchase.
